learning_objective: 🎯 Learn to become a data detective by collecting real information and turning it into fun, easy-to-read picture graphs!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Data is just a fancy word for collected information. We can ask our friends their favorite ice cream flavor to collect some yummy data!
Instead of writing numbers over and over, we draw straight lines called tally marks. Every 5th mark crosses the other four, making counting super fast!
A pictograph uses fun pictures to show numbers! If one smiley face picture means 10 students, then 3 smiley faces mean 30 students.

fun_activity.title: 📊 Family Favorite Fruit Chart
fun_activity.instructions: Ask everyone in your family what their favorite fruit is. Use fun tally marks to record their answers on a notepad to see which fruit wins!

quick_recap: ⭐ Data is information we collect by asking questions or observing things.
⭐ Tally marks help us count and record information in quick groups of five.
⭐ Pictographs use pictures or symbols to make numbers look colorful and fun!
